text_block_list.text:
As a result of the fan voting, Grass 
Wonder magnificently earned the right to 
run in the Arima Kinen.

With the direct showdown against 
Maruzensky finally drawing near, Grass 
Wonder could not contain the rising 
excitement in her heart.

However, due to an injury sustained during 
training, Maruzensky gives up on running 
in the Arima Kinen.

Grass Wonder also learned that she had 
planned to retire from the Twinkle Series 
after the Arima Kinen.
